ui.title: Settings
ui.features_help: Any feature can be turned off on its own: the behaviour stops, the parameters are kept.
ui.keywords_help: Requests about memory are recognised by keywords (D29). Click a default word to disable it (strikethrough), add your own phrasing below; click a custom word to remove it.
ui.confirm_restore: Restore every setting to its default? Nothing is written until you save.
ui.restored: Restored to defaults; click Save to write the file.
ui.restart_hint: Restart AstrBot for changes to take effect.
ui.astrbot_help: The thinking model used for conversation is whatever is selected in the AstrBot web UI; this shows the models enabled in AstrBot's config. Without AstrBot (command-line platform) it is configured in .env.
ui.chart_note: Three lines, three kinds of memory: the more emotional and important, the slower it fades. Change the parameters on the left, or the three pairs of numbers below, and watch the curves move.
ui.chart_help: The x-axis is memory time (on the memory clock: fast while chatting, almost frozen when idle); the y-axis is memory strength. The three lines are three imagined memories; the more emotional and important, the slower they fade: half-life = base half-life × emotion factor^emotion × importance factor^importance (× edge bonus). Once a curve drops below the dashed line (forgetting threshold) it leaves scanning and waits for batch forgetting. Change a parameter on the left and the chart updates at once.
ui.emotion_help: How worked up this made it: 0 = as usual, 1 = most intense. Called relative arousal a in the formula.
ui.importance_help: How much this matters to the person: 0 = trivial, 1 = life-changing. Called importance i in the formula.
ui.edge_label: Count as the first/last segment of a conversation (edge bonus)
ui.example_reset_title: Reset the three emotion/importance pairs, the edge bonus and the x-axis (parameters on the left are untouched)
ui.persona_help: Who it is, how it talks, its habits — written by you, usually a few thousand characters at most. Used for replies and for messages it sends on its own (D29). Stored as persona.md in the data folder; takes effect as soon as it is saved, no restart. Keep the name consistent with “Its name”.
ui.persona_loaded: Loaded “{f}”; click “Save persona” to write it.
ui.persona_saved: Persona saved to {p}; in effect now.
ui.persona_star: If you like it, consider giving the author a ⭐
ui.persona_unreadable: Could not read the persona file
ui.persona_also_saved: The persona was saved too and is in effect now.
ui.libs_note: All are other people's work; use under their licences. SillyTavern character cards are PNG or JSON — copy the text of description / personality in here. Personas from the AstrBot market can be used as they are.

general.title: Data location
general.help: The memory database (with its archive), persona, lifecycle state, action log and images all live in the data folder.

models.title: Models
models.help: Two-model design: the thinking model handles the conversation; the subconscious model tidies memory in the background; each can be local or a cloud API. The thinking model is chosen in the AstrBot web UI (or in .env for the command-line platform); the subconscious model is chosen here, and each vendor's connection fields appear only when that vendor is selected. API keys go in .env only.

lifecycle.title: Start-up
lifecycle.help: Familiar phase → start-up → running phase. During the familiar phase the full chat history is sent as usual; once usage reaches the start-up token count, every conversation is consolidated at once and the probability sea is built.

forgetting.title: Forgetting curve
forgetting.help: Memory strength S(t) = 0.5^(Δt / H). Half-life H = base half-life × emotion factor^a × importance factor^i × edge bonus, where a is relative arousal and i is importance (0–1).

clock.title: Memory clock
clock.help: Decay runs on conversation time, not calendar time: fast while chatting, slower after a pause, stopped after long enough. Not using the system for a long time does not erase everything (D21).

scanner.title: Scanning and surfacing
scanner.help: The scanner polls one month-partition per minute. Each segment is Bernoulli-sampled: P = 1 − e^(−p·Δt), p = rate cap · σ((S + priming − threshold) / T). Hits enter the surfacing buffer.

budget.title: Context budget
budget.help: In the running phase the memory handed to the thinking model has three parts, each with a cap; their sum is the total budget for memory.

fresh.title: Fresh memory
fresh.help: In the running phase no chat history is attached: what was just said stays present as almost-undecayed memory (D30, D31).

resident.title: Resident bar
resident.help: Besides exempt items (profile sources, things the user asked to remember, repeatedly mentioned), threads compete for seats by weighted score. Resident items do not decay and are not scanned.

sweep.title: Batch forgetting and archive
sweep.help: Segments below the forgetting threshold queue up; a full batch is processed at once: most move to the archive (original text kept, searchable), a random few are abstracted to keywords and start decaying afresh.

archive.title: Archive search
archive.help: Archive search: jieba tokenisation + BM25 ranking over archived segments' titles and original text. Runs only when the user asks (D26).

runner.title: Subconscious consolidation
runner.help: After a pause the subconscious model consolidates: segment, score, attach to threads, tune; duplicate threads are merged at night.

merge.title: Thread merging
merge.help: At night, recently created threads are checked and merged into existing ones when they duplicate them.

candidates.title: Thread candidates
candidates.help: Candidate threads offered to the subconscious model when deciding where a segment belongs: union of recently active ∪ keyword overlap ∪ shared people and other sources.

boundaries.title: Segment boundaries
boundaries.help: First-layer segmentation rules: split conversations by time gap and force candidate boundaries where a stretch runs too long.

profile.title: Profile conflicts
profile.help: When a new fact contradicts an old one in the profile, dice are rolled by the old fact's firmness: evoke / overwrite / neither (D16).

attachments.title: Files and images
attachments.help: Images go straight to the thinking model; files are extracted to text for the current prompt, with only a summary kept in memory (D38).

action.title: Autonomous action limits
action.help: QQ actions {name} performs on its own under strict rate limits (D35): each action at most N times per window (days adjustable).

general.ai_name.label: Its name
general.ai_name.help: The name you gave it; used in this page's explanations. How it calls itself in chat is up to the persona file.

general.data_dir.label: Data folder
general.data_dir.help: Where memory.db (probability sea and archive), persona.md, lifecycle.json, action_log.json and images/ are stored. Relative paths are resolved from the project root. Under Docker only paths inside the project work unless you mount the target folder in docker-compose.yml. Old data is not migrated automatically; copy the files over by hand.

models.thinking_context_limit.label: Thinking model context limit
models.thinking_context_limit.help: Maximum context length of the thinking model (tokens); update it when you switch models. Start-up is now by token count (D43); this value is only used for other estimates.

models.subconscious_provider.label: Subconscious model provider
models.subconscious_provider.help: Ollama: runs locally (recommended; consolidation never leaves your machine; needs a GPU). Everything else uses an OpenAI-compatible API: the listed vendors have preset addresses, the key goes in OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY in .env (DeepSeek uses DEEPSEEK_API_KEY); for an unlisted service choose “custom address” and fill in the URL below. The subconscious model must reliably output JSON; models under 7B consolidate noticeably worse.

models.subconscious_model.label: Subconscious model
models.subconscious_model.help: Model name. The default Qwen 27B Q4 quant needs about 17 GB of VRAM (e.g. RTX 3090/4090); with less VRAM use a 7B–14B model at some cost in consolidation quality.

models.openai_compat_base_url.label: OpenAI-compatible API address
models.openai_compat_base_url.help: Used when the provider is the custom OpenAI-compatible option, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com or http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1. The key goes in OPENAI_COMPAT_API_KEY in .env.

models.deepseek_thinking.label: Subconscious model: DeepSeek thinking mode
models.deepseek_thinking.help: When the subconscious provider is DeepSeek: reason before consolidating, more accurate but slower and more tokens. Unrelated to the thinking model (chosen in AstrBot).

models.ollama_base_url.label: Ollama address
models.ollama_base_url.help: Address of the local Ollama service. Under Docker docker-compose.yml rewrites it to host.docker.internal.

models.ollama_keep_alive.label: Ollama keep-alive
models.ollama_keep_alive.help: How long an idle model stays loaded, e.g. 30m or 2h. Loading a large model the first time takes 1–2 minutes.

models.ollama_num_ctx.label: Ollama context length
models.ollama_num_ctx.help: How much the subconscious model can read at once. Larger uses more VRAM; the segmentation batch size (Consolidation → segmentation batch) must be well below it.

lifecycle.start_tokens.label: Start-up token count
lifecycle.start_tokens.help: The memory system starts once context usage reaches this many tokens (D43; default 60,000, adjustable). Not a fraction of the limit: with a 1M-token model, waiting for 70% would make the familiar phase so long the system never kicks in. Start-up happens only once.

forgetting.base_half_life.label: Base half-life
forgetting.base_half_life.help: Half-life of an unremarkable moment (a = i = 0).

forgetting.emotion_max.label: Emotion factor
forgetting.emotion_max.help: How much the half-life is multiplied when relative arousal is 1, interpolated exponentially.

forgetting.importance_max.label: Importance factor
forgetting.importance_max.help: How much the half-life is multiplied when importance is 1, interpolated exponentially.

forgetting.reinforce.label: Reinforcement strength
forgetting.reinforce.help: Retrieval reinforcement: when a memory is actually used, S returns to full and H × (1 + strength × (1 − S)). The closer to forgotten, the stronger the reinforcement.

forgetting.position_bonus.label: Edge bonus
forgetting.position_bonus.help: Half-life multiplier for the first and last segment of a conversation (primacy and recency).

forgetting.forget_line.label: Forgetting threshold
forgetting.forget_line.help: Below this S the memory counts as forgotten: it leaves scan sampling and joins the clean-up queue.

forgetting.adjust_step_max.label: Single tuning cap
forgetting.adjust_step_max.help: Largest factor by which the subconscious model may change one memory's half-life in a single step; the floor is its reciprocal (guard rail).

forgetting.adjust_total_max.label: Cumulative tuning cap
forgetting.adjust_total_max.help: Largest cumulative factor for one memory; the floor is its reciprocal (guard rail).

forgetting.decay_model.label: Decay curve
forgetting.decay_model.help: Shape of the strength-over-time curve. Exponential is the default; power-law has a longer tail so old things fade slower; no-decay is for debugging only. You can also drop your own curve into plugins/ in the data folder (see contracts/plugins.py).

warnings.不遗忘: No-decay is for debugging only: memories only accumulate, the surfacing buffer and resident bar get ever more crowded, each turn's context grows longer and costlier, and it errors once the thinking model's limit is exceeded. For normal use choose exponential or power-law decay.

clock.speed.label: Chat speed
clock.speed.help: Memory time relative to real time while a conversation is active.

clock.idle_after.label: Slow-down delay
clock.idle_after.help: How long after the last message the clock starts slowing down.

clock.idle_rate.label: Slowed rate
clock.idle_rate.help: Rate after slowing down, relative to chat speed.

clock.freeze_after.label: Freeze delay
clock.freeze_after.help: How long after slowing down memory time stops completely.

scanner.buffer_size.label: Surfacing buffer size
scanner.buffer_size.help: How many segments the surfacing buffer holds at once, FIFO replacement. Surfacing alone does not reinforce.

scanner.threshold.label: Surfacing threshold
scanner.threshold.help: Centre of the sigmoid: when S + priming equals it, p is half the rate cap.

scanner.temp_focus.label: Focused temperature T
scanner.temp_focus.help: Temperature while staying on one topic: low temperature makes sampling more deterministic, strong memories surface more consistently.

scanner.temp_diffuse.label: Diffuse temperature T
scanner.temp_diffuse.help: Temperature during small talk: high temperature makes sampling more random, weak memories get a chance.

scanner.focus_turns.label: Focus threshold
scanner.focus_turns.help: How many consecutive user messages on one topic count as fully focused (temperature down to the focused value).

scanner.rate.label: Rate cap
scanner.rate.help: Upper bound on surfacing intensity per minute. At 0.02 the strongest, most relevant memory surfaces about every 50 minutes.

scanner.priming_max.label: Priming cap
scanner.priming_max.help: Priming effect: the largest bonus a segment gets for matching the current topic's keywords.

scanner.person_bonus.label: Person bonus
scanner.person_bonus.help: Bonus when the people in a segment overlap with the current topic.

scanner.negative_damp.label: Negative damping
scanner.negative_damp.help: How much, at most, a negative segment's surfacing probability drops when the topic is unrelated.

scanner.surface_policy.label: Surfacing policy
scanner.surface_policy.help: Which memories enter the surfacing buffer. Probabilistic is the default (Bernoulli sampling); relevance search takes only the few most related to the topic, no sampling; off means memories appear only as fresh memory, in the resident bar, or on archive search. You can also drop your own policy into plugins/ in the data folder.

budget.resident.label: Resident budget
budget.resident.help: Most tokens the resident block (profile + always-remembered threads) may use. When over, the profile is kept first, then exempt threads.

budget.surfaced.label: Surfacing budget
budget.surfaced.help: Most tokens the surfacing area may use.

budget.fresh.label: Fresh-memory budget
budget.fresh.help: Most tokens the just-said messages may use. When over, the oldest give way first (they are still consolidated into memory).

fresh.floor.label: Presence floor
fresh.floor.help: Messages with strength at or above this stay present without sampling.

fresh.half_life.label: Fresh-memory half-life
fresh.half_life.help: Half-life used for messages not yet scored.

fresh.split_at.label: Mid-chat consolidation trigger
fresh.split_at.help: When the oldest unconsolidated message drops to this strength, a batch is consolidated mid-conversation. Must be above the presence floor.

fresh.split_upto.label: Mid-chat consolidation range
fresh.split_upto.help: The batch covers messages below this strength; newer ones wait for the next batch. Must be above the trigger.

resident.seats.label: Competed seats
resident.seats.help: Number of resident seats open to competition.

resident.w_importance.label: Weight: importance
resident.w_importance.help: Score = Σ weight × component. The four weights should sum to about 1.

resident.w_activity.label: Weight: activity
resident.w_activity.help: As above. Activity decays from the last mention.

resident.w_recall.label: Weight: recall frequency
resident.w_recall.help: As above. Recall frequency = count / (count + saturation).

resident.ongoing_factor.label: Ongoing factor
resident.ongoing_factor.help: Score multiplier for threads that are still ongoing.

resident.activity_half_life.label: Activity half-life
resident.activity_half_life.help: How long without a mention halves activity.

resident.repeated_conversations.label: Repeated-mention threshold
resident.repeated_conversations.help: Mentioned in at least this many different conversations counts as exempt “repeatedly mentioned”.

sweep.batch_size.label: Batch size
sweep.batch_size.help: How many queued segments trigger one batch.

sweep.keep_ratio.label: Keep ratio
sweep.keep_ratio.help: Fraction of each batch kept at random for keyword abstraction (at least 1).

sweep.excerpt_chars.label: Abstraction excerpt
sweep.excerpt_chars.help: How much original text the subconscious model sees when abstracting to keywords.

archive.excerpt_chars.label: Result excerpt length
archive.excerpt_chars.help: How much original text the thinking model sees per result.

runner.thread_confidence_min.label: Attach confidence threshold
runner.thread_confidence_min.help: Below this confidence that a segment belongs to a thread, a new thread is created.

runner.segment_budget.label: Segmentation batch
runner.segment_budget.help: Maximum tokens per batch of messages when segmenting; must be well below the subconscious model's context length.

runner.pause.label: Pause threshold
runner.pause.help: How long a conversation must pause before consolidation starts.

runner.night_hour.label: Nightly merge hour
runner.night_hour.help: After which hour of the day thread merging runs once.

merge.recent_days.label: Recent window
merge.recent_days.help: Threads created within this many days are checked for merging.

merge.confidence_min.label: Merge confidence threshold
merge.confidence_min.help: Merge only at or above this confidence. Keep it above the attach threshold: a wrong merge is harder to notice than a wrong new thread.

candidates.max_total.label: Total candidates
candidates.max_total.help: Maximum candidate threads offered at once.

candidates.recent.label: Recently active
candidates.recent.help: How many of the most recently active threads to include.

candidates.keyword.label: Keyword overlap
candidates.keyword.help: How many threads to include by BM25 keyword overlap.

candidates.min_alias_len.label: Minimum name length
candidates.min_alias_len.help: Minimum characters in a name for person matching (very short names mismatch easily).

boundaries.conversation_gap_minutes.label: Conversation gap
boundaries.conversation_gap_minutes.help: A silence longer than this starts a new conversation.

boundaries.max_turns.label: Maximum messages
boundaries.max_turns.help: Force a candidate boundary after this many messages since the last one.

boundaries.max_minutes.label: Maximum duration
boundaries.max_minutes.help: Force a candidate boundary after this long since the last one.

profile.firm_half_life.label: Firmness half-life
profile.firm_half_life.help: How long without a mention halves an old fact's firmness.

profile.evoke_min.label: Minimum evoke probability
profile.evoke_min.help: Probability that the least firm old fact is evoked.

profile.evoke_max.label: Maximum evoke probability
profile.evoke_max.help: Probability that the firmest old fact is evoked.

profile.overwrite_max.label: Maximum overwrite probability
profile.overwrite_max.help: Probability that the least firm old fact is overwritten (moved to the archive).

attachments.max_mb.label: File size limit
attachments.max_mb.help: Files larger than this are not read.

attachments.prompt_chars.label: Prompt character limit
attachments.prompt_chars.help: Maximum characters of one file put into the prompt; the rest is cut.

attachments.memory_chars.label: Memory excerpt length
attachments.memory_chars.help: How much of a file's beginning is recorded in memory.

action.find_times.label: Find images: times
action.find_times.help: Maximum image searches within the window.

action.find_days.label: Find images: window
action.find_days.help: Length of the rate window for image searches.

action.avatar_times.label: Change avatar: times
action.avatar_times.help: Maximum avatar changes within the window.

action.avatar_days.label: Change avatar: window
action.avatar_days.help: Length of the rate window for avatar changes.

action.nickname_times.label: Change nickname: times
action.nickname_times.help: Maximum nickname changes within the window.

action.nickname_days.label: Change nickname: window
action.nickname_days.help: Length of the rate window for nickname changes.

action.signature_times.label: Change signature: times
action.signature_times.help: Maximum signature changes within the window.

action.signature_days.label: Change signature: window
action.signature_days.help: Length of the rate window for signature changes.

action.post_days.label: Post moment: window
action.post_days.help: Length of the rate window for posts.

action.delete_days.label: Delete moment: window
action.delete_days.help: Length of the rate window for deletions.

action.post_visibility.label: Moment visibility
action.post_visibility.help: Who can see moments the AI posts on its own in QQ Zone.

batch_sweep.label: Batch forgetting
batch_sweep.help: When off, segments below the forgetting threshold just stop being sampled and are not moved to the archive.

mid_chat_split.label: Mid-chat consolidation
mid_chat_split.help: In a long conversation without pauses, consolidate a batch before fresh memory expires (D31).

read_images.label: Read images
read_images.help: Pass images the user sends to the thinking model (the model must support image input).

read_files.label: Read files
read_files.help: Extract the content of files the user sends (PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, text, code…).

keyword_requests.label: Keyword memory requests
keyword_requests.help: Recognise requests like “remember”, “forget”, “check the archive” (D29). When off, these are treated as ordinary chat.

persona_reminder.label: Persona reminder
persona_reminder.help: Add a one-line persona reminder every turn so the tone is not pulled off by the chat history.

web_search.label: Web search
web_search.help: Use AstrBot's built-in web search (D36); source and key are configured in AstrBot.

memory_search.label: Recall on its own
memory_search.help: Let {name} search its memory with a tool (not the archive, D26) when something does not surface by itself.

time_awareness.label: Knows the current time
time_awareness.help: Each turn, tell {name} the current date, weekday and time, and how long since the last chat.

qq_find_images.label: Find images autonomously
qq_find_images.help: Let {name} search the web for images (Openverse, Creative Commons) and save them to images/ in the data folder, for avatars and post pictures.

qq_set_avatar.label: Change avatar autonomously
qq_set_avatar.help: Let {name} change its QQ avatar on its own (images from images/ in the data folder).

qq_set_nickname.label: Change nickname autonomously
qq_set_nickname.help: Let {name} change its QQ nickname on its own.

qq_set_signature.label: Change signature autonomously
qq_set_signature.help: Let {name} change its QQ signature on its own.

qq_post_moment.label: Post moments autonomously
qq_post_moment.help: Let {name} post QQ Zone moments on its own.

forget.label: Ask to forget
forget.help: Starts the forgetting flow: confirm which event, then the user chooses permanent deletion or archiving (D25).

archive.label: Ask to check the archive
archive.help: Triggers an archive search (D26: only when the user asks).

remember.label: Ask to remember
remember.help: When a user message contains any of these, its segment is marked “asked to remember” (resident, exempt from competition).

choice_erase.label: Choice: delete permanently
choice_erase.help: Phrasings that choose permanent deletion in the forgetting flow.

choice_archive.label: Choice: archive
choice_archive.help: Phrasings that choose archiving in the forgetting flow.

choice_cancel.label: Choice: cancel
choice_cancel.help: Phrasings that cancel the forgetting flow.
